recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy action shot of a musician with long curly hair captured mid-jump while playing a red electric guitar. The subject is suspended against a clear blue sky, with the lower edge of the frame showing a shoreline with white sea foam. The lighting is natural and bright, emphasizing the texture of the hair and the metallic sheen of the guitar.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject suspension against a minimalist blue background
Diagonal line created by the guitar neck and the jumper's body
Contrast between the red guitar body and the cool blue sky
Kinetic energy of the hair versus the frozen mid-air posture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally located, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame, creating a sense of weightlessness.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red body of the electric guitar acts as the primary color and structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal of the guitar neck up to the subject's face and explosive hair, then down the curved line of the legs.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive blue sky provides significant negative space that emphasizes the isolation and height of the jump.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean blue sky acting as a clean, expansive backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red of the guitar body providing a sharp focal point.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White of the tank top and sea foam providing high-value highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the guitar and sky; natural skin tones and textured gray/patterned trousers provide organic balance.

graphicDevices: Natural motion blur in the hair
Low-angle perspective to enhance jump height

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man with long curly blonde hair jumping high in the air at a beach. He is barefoot, wearing a white tank top and striped trousers, playing a red angular electric guitar. The background is a clear blue sky with a sliver of ocean and white foam at the very bottom. The lighting is bright daylight.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply any desired band name or album title in the upper third of the image using a distressed sans-serif or bold display font to match the rock aesthetic.

verificationChecks: Is the subject fully suspended in the air?
Is the guitar a vibrant red?
Is the hair captured with a sense of motion?
Is the horizon line low in the frame?

adjustableVariables: Specific shape of the electric guitar
Time of day (golden hour vs. midday blue)
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the guitar headstock
Identifiable facial features of specific celebrities

mustAchieve: Clean separation between subject and sky

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the guitar strings and frets are rendered clearly.
Check that the feet are not touching the ground or water.
Verify the hair texture looks like individual strands in motion.
Confirm the red of the guitar is the most saturated element.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dynamic mid-air human subject with a high-contrast prop against a minimalist, single-tone natural background to create an iconic, high-energy portrait.
